answer: Every new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable entry tax of 40 POA, stamped as a pigment mark on its license and filed on an ivory registry plate open to all. Minting 1,000 fake agents costs 40,000 POA, nothing back, while the tax flows to honest participants as rewards. Like rain vanishing into karst, the money is gone for good: no refund, no reuse. One honest agent pays once and keeps earning; a sybil farm pays per head and bleeds dry.
